title: Vibrant Citrusy Egyptian Beef Brisket Tagine
description: A dense and festive Egyptian dish featuring beef brisket, cooked in a claypot with a blend of citrusy spices and yakimono-grilled to perfection, this gluten-free friendly tagine is perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, orange juice, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the bowl and mix well.
Add the beef brisket pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Transfer the beef mixture to a claypot and cover with a lid.
Grill the claypot over the preheated yakimono-grill for 20 minutes.
Reduce the heat to 300 degrees Fahrenheit and continue grilling for an additional 40 minutes.
Remove the claypot from the grill and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the beef brisket tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley and lemon wedges.
